The '''Sebiris system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], within the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]], on the [[Sebiris Run]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]].
